Nice to meet you! I'm a big fan of Mr. Shirokaku: ！！！！

I always enjoy your too cute illustrations and movies on Twitter.
I love the deformation of the characters and the attention to detail in the quality of the images,
I love your sense of style! Thank you so much for creating such wonderful works. 。。。。

I wanted to see the OC "Ying Yang Brothers" from the game "Breakfast in the Sanctuary" created by Shirohatsu-san in his world view movie, so I asked him to do it for me!
They look like pandas working in a dirty Chinese restaurant in a back alley called "Ying Yang Hang Ten" with a design that looks like the Ying Yang symbol.

Here are the characters' materials! ↓↓
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12RmvrCSxGxTfbxdvnWStPEyMR2KEIzEa?usp=share_link

The character is moody, unfriendly and violent. Clothes and other designs should be easy to draw,
You don't have to reproduce the design faithfully at all.

(I don't think it will be useful as a reference since she is not a main character, but I'll put up the game of the main story at https://karoooomecakes.wixsite.com/game/sanctuary )

I apologize for the length of this article.
If you are so inclined, please do not hesitate to contact me!
